# pandas

These helpers upload pandas DataFrames and query channel values as pandas Series or DataFrames.
Use {py:func}`~nominal.thirdparty.pandas.channel_to_series` for one channel, or
{py:func}`~nominal.thirdparty.pandas.datasource_to_dataframe` for a data source.

To download a dataset file to disk instead of querying channel values, use
{py:meth}`~nominal.core.DatasetFile.download`.

```{eval-rst}
.. automodule:: nominal.thirdparty.pandas
```
